name: Cancel order button
description: Cancels the open order while the store hasn't started it.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/cancel-order-button", name: "Cancel order button", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "Cancels the open order while the store hasn't started it.",
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    If(condition: options.order.status == "pending" || options.order.status == "confirmed", then: Button(label: "Cancel order", style: ButtonStyle.secondary, fullWidth: true, onTap: CancelOrder()), else: Text(child: "This order can no longer be cancelled.", size: FontSize.sm, color: Color.textMuted))
  )], options: [DataOption(name: "order", type: Order, required: true)],
)
